name: notes-site
description: Turn folders of LaTeX books, Markdown notes and PDFs into a notes website with search, highlights, typed notes and handwriting.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: esbuild src/client/app.ts src/client/notes.ts src/client/ink.ts src/client/nav.ts src/client/pdf.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2019 --minify --sourcemap --outdir=dist/client
